title: A 3-slot events block shows only about 30 days of a repeating series, because the SQL LIMIT counts dates, not series

source.ref: SERIES-PD, left out of LIVE-684 (#3097, ADR-1680) because it needs a migration; plan §2.3 and risk R9

detail:
FILED 2026-09-30 out of LIVE-684 (#3097, ADR-1680). THE CONSEQUENCE: on the three 3-slot surfaces (the Channel strip and both rail events panels) the query takes the next N rows and the JS fold (collapseSeries) then collapses a repeating series to one card, so a daily series can fill the whole LIMIT and push every other event past the horizon; the block reads as roughly the next 30 days. hasMore still offers the way out, and the plan's QA fixture makes the limit visible, which is why the plan ruled it acceptable for v1 (EVENTS-SERIES-BUILD-PLAN.md §12 question 9).

THE FIX, named in the plan as SERIES-PD: push the fold into SQL with DISTINCT ON (coalesce(parent_event_id, id)) so the LIMIT counts series, not rows. It needs a functional index on coalesce(parent_event_id, id) and turns each surface's read into an RPC or view, each a new leak-contract surface that must re-apply the caller's visibility gate. The JS fold stays the authority either way: collapseSeries over an already-distinct list is the identity function.

── PARKED 2026-09-30 with the owner's P3 sort (ADR-1682, recorded by HYG-157): park until after launch. REVISIT TRIGGER: reopen after launch, on the first real paid order or the first six weeks of live Spaces, whichever comes first, or sooner if a 3-slot block is seen hiding events in production.
notes: parkedUntil: after launch (2026-12-21); reopen on the first real paid order or the first six weeks of live Spaces, whichever comes first. Filed from LIVE-684 (ADR-1680); parked with the owner's P3 sort 2026-09-30 (ADR-1682).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='supabase/migrations';const hit=fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f)=>f.endsWith('.sql')).some((f)=>/distinct\s+on\s*\(\s*coalesce\s*\(\s*parent_event_id\s*,\s*id\s*\)\s*\)/i.test(fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8')));if(!hit){console.error('LIVE-731: no migration pushes the series fold into SQL with DISTINCT ON (coalesce(parent_event_id, id))');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails until a migration pushes the series fold into SQL. Not run while parked.
